text: Implemented retained server identity, protected key records, invite, local guard, and authenticated HTTPS; just check passes.

Implemented pinned native connect/status and saved per-destination credentials. CLI/API integration, proxy renewal/replacement, redirect non-disclosure, and just check passed; native Windows binary remains untested because the VM has no Rust toolchain.
Removed static tokens, client TLS bypass flags, remote plaintext and obsolete serve paths; updated help, specs, recipes, and regression coverage. just check passed.
Implemented durable key listing and revocation, cutoff for new operations and active streams, and verified two-key behavior across restart.
Implemented offline disconnect, saved-client credential refresh, safe replacement and recovery, with focused secure-sharing checks.
Review is scoped and linked after browser and MCP delivery, before final validation.
Shared MCP dispatcher, saved-key reload, disconnect/replacement, and revocation checks passed.
Codex CLI 0.158.0-alpha.2 launched local stdio MCP, fed and read; native fetch confirmed the sequence.
Saved native MCP works; protocol, revocation, and Codex feed/read checks passed.
OAuth tests cover PKCE, callback/resource binding, CSRF, replay, refresh, restart, and revocation.
Codex CLI OAuth login and HTTPS MCP feed/read passed; native fetch confirmed sequence 9019.
OAuth-protected HTTPS MCP and Codex tool calls passed.
Two sessions, ten runs per condition; each lane verified 100 appends and 100 exact reads per run.
512B and 4KiB local MCP: 45-51% of native; direct HTTPS MCP: 71-78%, warm macOS loopback.
Published benchmark harness, raw sessions, latency, variation, and workload limits.

Page click flow in a real browser is unverified; API and HTML route checks pass.
Session tests pass for login, cookie reuse after restart, logout, Origin rejection, and key revocation.
Real Chrome/Safari page login and pool read/write remain unverified.
Mac exact-leaf trust adapter, status, removal, and renewal code exists; restricted certificate parsing tests pass.
Chrome/Safari OS approval, renewal, and removal need an interactive macOS desktop check.
Windows Root trust import was tested headlessly; OS blocked confirmation and issuer-wide effects remain unknown.
Windows install stays disabled until signed-in Chrome/Edge and TLS issuer-scope checks pass.
Codex CLI OAuth login and direct HTTPS MCP feed/read passed; native fetch confirmed the message.
Claude Code model login is unavailable; its read/write, restart, and renewal remain unverified.
Chrome showed local settings and the test key changing from Active to Revoked after CLI action.
Assets: pool data, access keys, grants, cookies. Attackers can reach remote HTTPS and forge local web requests.
Native TLS checks name, expiry, and SPKI pin before key use; redirects cannot carry keys to another origin.
Shared key records gate native, browser, and MCP calls. Revocation persists, rejects new work, and wakes waits.
Local admin checks Host and Origin; remote listener has no admin routes. Forged local requests fail.
Browser sessions use hashed key-linked records and Secure HttpOnly SameSite cookies; revoked keys fail each call.
OAuth binds PKCE code to client, callback, issuer, and MCP resource; CSRF, replay, rotation, restart checks pass.
MCP checks each POST and tool admission. Secrets stay out of URLs, discovery, normal output, and raw benchmarks.
Residual: restoring an old server-state backup can restore revoked keys; guard backups and re-revoke after restore.
Residual: admitted work may finish after revoke; docs bound idle waits to 60 seconds and new work fails.
Windows Root trust stays disabled until issuer scope and signed-in browser behavior are proved.
Sol-high independent review found no release-blocking code flaw or simpler shared-authority design.
Reviewed implemented trust boundaries and recorded residual risks and unvalidated platform paths.
Combined integration test uses one key across native, browser, local MCP, direct MCP; revoke rejects all four.
A second key stays valid; public inventory has no live static-token or TLS-bypass options.
Final just check passes with loopback permission; Sol-high review found no blocking code flaw.
Benchmark gives 512B and 4KiB ratios; docs label unsupported Windows trust and unverified browser paths.
Interactive browser, Mac/Windows trust, and Claude Code acceptance checks remain open.
Claude Code 2.1.280 local MCP fed/read seq 1, then a fresh process fetched it through the saved key.
Claude Code 2.1.280 OAuth login and direct HTTPS MCP fed/read seq 2; a fresh process fetched it.
Native saved connection with the same key followed seq 2 and returned the Claude direct message.
Claude local MCP gave an access connect hint after disconnect, then read seq 2 after reconnect.
Claude and Codex local MCP setup, feed/read, restart, disconnect, and recovery checks passed.
Claude renewed its expired 900-second token without browser approval; one grant remained and new expiry persisted.
Claude direct MCP fetched after server restart using its saved grant; native access with the same key read seq 2.
Chrome 153 and Safari 26.6.2 loaded local access and pool pages; rebuilt UI fixed visited-link contrast.
Chrome and Safari rejected the untrusted disposable HTTPS leaf; remote page flow awaits approved trust.
Mac trust remains uninstalled pending action-time approval; native saved access is still accepted.
Signed-in Windows wizard reached Current User Root final review; canceled before import without approval.
Root has zero matching test entries; VM lacks an enabled standard-user account, so issuer scope remains untested.
Claude local/direct feed-read, restart, natural OAuth renewal, and native same-key read passed.
After owner revocation, Claude direct MCP reported Needs authentication; no tool was exposed.
Claude local MCP tool rejected seq 2 with invalid access key; native status showed accepted=false.
Real Claude and native checks confirmed key revocation; disposable grants and saved credentials were removed.
Rebuilt local UI shows readable visited links in Chrome and Safari; no browser key write was authorized.
Chrome login, append/read, restart cookie, logout, and revocation passed after HTTP/2 and composer fixes.
Mac exact-leaf install and same-key renewal passed; exact removal awaits user SecurityAgent approval.
Owner-supplied HTTPS leaf passed curl health and MCP discovery, and Chrome accepted the original address.
Live Chrome exposed HTTP/2 and composer bugs; fixes and real HTTP/2 TLS regression pass.
Safari check awaits user opening localhost; automatic review blocked an unrelated private window.
Local Access page rendered in Chrome; Create key click awaits action-time approval for a disposable key.

Fresh clients rejected renewed and child certificates; after exact HKCU cleanup all rejected the original again.
Import-Certificate and both product removal paths failed in VM; setup stays disabled, standard user untested.
Exact Mac test leaf d57884f6 is absent from login keychain; pending removal process has exited.
Chrome page created and revoked Mac-QA-UI; native write/read passed, then revoked write failed. Headless check remains.
Mac accepted CA-signed leaf, rejected child. Product install/removal await OS prompt; F6DA30F8 remains trusted.
Local page created and revoked a key; native use was denied after revoke. Settings and admin guards passed.
Chrome HTTPS login, append/read, reload, logout, reconnect, and key-revocation cutoff passed on localhost.
Browser session lifecycle passed in Chrome; cookie, origin, and hostile-content tests pass in just check.
Product installed CA-signed leaf; Chrome login and write passed. Exact untrust cleared keychain and SSL trust.
Chrome page matched serve flags; local key activity and revoke passed. Forged admin tests pass.
